paired200.source: paper/evidence/resources.json, from the completed paired trial

older_integration_allowance.qualification: This older per-run pilot allowance is a documented bounded precedent, not proof of a project-wide remaining balance.

recorded_limits_and_usage.global_cumulative_ledger: Not reconstructed in this review. Required for a claim about total remaining budget, not intrinsically necessary for a separately bounded scientific batch.

recommended_minimal_batch.condition_design: Binding-only vs fully typed generation/scoring on identical free-form source questions. Hold question/context binding fixed to isolate task-kind. Store exact native delivered prompts before inference.
recommended_minimal_batch.source_selection: Freeze stable source/hash selection before new generation outcomes. No replacement after failures; preserve paired denominators.
stop_conditions: Model not present in fresh catalogue
Request count or prompt-byte/max-output bound violated
Missing usage accounting, transport/capture failure or provider billing limit cannot be reconciled; preserve result and stop before another request
Cumulative ledger plus conservative next-request reservation exceeds the explicit local allowance
recommended_minimal_batch.missing_outputs: Retain every planned row and one-attempt status. Bound unknown semantic correctness0..1; do not drop incomplete/empty responses or silently replace models/cases.
recommended_minimal_batch.scoring_limit: Exact/alias fixture controls can be evaluated deterministically. A full official MixEval model score may require its grader protocol; do not relabel a literal-match diagnostic as official accuracy.

price_planning.source: scripts/run_adaption_pilot.py main blob a994d53a03a2d4770d1d0aa22453fd6439c4b683; comment says verified2026-11-06
price_planning.units: Historical Adaption credits per million input/output tokens
price_planning.qualification: This is a planning proxy at recorded rates, not a verified current monetary ceiling. Prompt bytes plus256 are not an exact provider tokenization bound, model overhead/pricing can change, and returned usage.cost currency is unspecified.
price_planning.recommended_allowance: A one-credit local reservation allowance is a documented precedent and comfortably exceeds the historical-rate80-request proxy. Parent must record the actual selected allowance in its frozen protocol. No blanket global-ledger gate is scientifically required.

official_docs.finding: Public API overview documents Responses and Models. No general account-balance endpoint established in the inspected overview.
Documents max_output_tokens, stream, explicit tools/no history, response usage. Public response-usage schema lists token usage but does not document a currency for observed cost.
Read-only dataset preprocessing quote includes availableCredits team balance, but requires an existing authorized document dataset ID. No dataset was created or probed to exploit this route.
Current official model list includes both proposed model aliases.

billing_discovery.reason: No local credential, no already-resolved authorized dataset ID and no general balance endpoint established. Do not invent /balance or create a dataset merely to expose a quote.

genuine_blockers: Local direct authenticated inference unavailable because credential is absent locally; use existing secure Actions path instead.
The parent must freeze new prompts, selected cases, request caps and branch guards before the launch.
An actual hard monetary cap cannot be certified solely from historical credit coefficients and currency-unknown usage.cost.
not_genuine_blockers: No need to ask user to paste/reveal the repository secret.
No need to reconstruct every prior project request before a small request/output-bounded batch.
No need to know remaining global credit balance to prepare and validate the reproducible bounded batch.
No need to substitute more offline variants when a bounded real-generation comparison would resolve the concrete scientific gap.
